acceptance_checks.check: Independent bounded card review saved as FCR-20261007-01. Error/result semantics and scope fixed; Q1 owned Windows lifecycle prototype and Q2 measured numeric policy freeze are explicit technical gates before their implementation, not proven completed code.

P-1: 5000-digit READY/manifest/document JSON yields controlled INVALID_JSON within byte cap, no stage/DB acceptance. Preserve Rejected before generic ValueError catch: DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY/NONFINITE_JSON/JSON_DEPTH/JSON_BOM/LIMIT_EXCEEDED and Unicode errors retain existing semantics. Trusted policy construction is a separate boundary: malformed policy raises declared controlled configuration exception before resource creation; controller reports configuration/IO error, not a package rejection or accepted receipt. Test parser + real entry points, no global integer-limit change.

P-2: Windows file owner/ACL/reparse/hardlink/identity checks cover READY/manifest/payload and nested directories, Bank/cache DB, existing SQLite sidecars before connect/recovery; newly created files checked before trusted reuse. On broad ACL refuse without repair or deletion. Prototype share/lifetime strategy in owned roots before adopting: normal write/commit/journal deletion, genuine hot-journal recovery after killed owned writer, reopen/read/search/replay/export and identity replacement race must pass. Check/recheck on opened handles where applicable; no incompatible read-only or exclusive sidecar lease. Supported DELETE journal mode unchanged; unsupported WAL/SHM remain explicit controlled refusal. Parent/SID trust threat scope unchanged; no administrator-resistance claim.

P-3: 64 notes ×3 old commit references with 1MiB original each: at most one complete original verification per distinct required commit per request, compact bounded summaries instead of cached full old documents; count chunk bytes, verification calls and summary memory. Hashes/ref checks remain mandatory, shared _verify_commit return contract preserved or all consumers adapted/tests run. Separate versioned experimental retained-work policy with aggregate byte/commit/summary/time caps and chunk cancellation; choose numeric defaults after measuring valid profile and record before code. Budget failure remains distinct from corruption through _verify_commit and wrappers. New import before commit: REJECTED/RETAINED_WORK_LIMIT and rollback; already accepted exact retry: IO_ERROR/RETAINED_WORK_LIMIT with explicit verification-incomplete diagnostic, no fake rejection/success receipt; after commit uncertainty: UNKNOWN and actual receipt lookup/same-ID recovery. No partial OK bytes/query results on limit, honour read API LIMIT_EXCEEDED mapping. Cancellation before commit rolls back, after commit cannot claim CANCELLED. Tiny injected-budget tests deterministic; timing is cooperative, no hard timeout guarantee. Preserve prepared package and exact retry. Existing64MiB/file256MiB/package unchanged; streaming, no unbounded cache/global int change/durable jobs.

P-5: subprocess captures localized CMD as bytes; bounded diagnostics decode explicitly with replacement, never None+str. Actual native test42 executes original junction assertion and passes, plus non-UTF8 bytes fixture. No OS codepage/privilege change.

New isolated fixes-run evidence records actual changed source hashes, command/exit, original/new case IDs, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and UI outcomes. Run affected intake/importer/reads/search/commands/producer/UI tests on same local/native sources; actual mapped owned UI demonstrates failure/cancel/retry/status mapping. Preserve original reports/receipts rather than overwriting them. Original four symlink tests remain BLOCKED unless actual original assertions run in permitted context; no substitute/history false-green. Scope acceptance distinguishes fulfilled criteria and explicit capability blockers; full R0/R1/production not accepted.

Append issue detected→card clarified→code fixed→actual retest evidence as separate states in canonical Findings/history/Review Log.
